user.title: House Rules
user.description: Simple automations written as sentences. After setup, “House Rules” appears in the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: House Rules is already set up.

pause.name: Pause rule
pause.description: Pauses a rule for a while.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long (0 = until switched on again).

reset_alarm_pin.name: Reset alarm PIN
reset_alarm_pin.description: Lifts the lockout after too many wrong PINs. Admins only.

remove_pin.name: Also remove the PIN
remove_pin.description: Also deletes the PIN (for example when it was forgotten). Until a new one is set, disarming needs no confirmation.

entity_missing.title: House Rules: device {entity_id} no longer exists

init.title: Replace device
init.description:
House Rules uses **{entity_id}**, but this device no longer exists in Home Assistant. Used in: {used_in}.

Choose another device: House Rules puts it everywhere {entity_id} was used.

error.invalid_entity: Please choose another device that exists.

abort.not_loaded: House Rules is not loaded right now.

entity_unavailable.title: House Rules: {entity_id} has been unavailable for {hours} hours

init.title: Replace device
init.description:
**{entity_id}** has been unavailable for {hours} hours (empty battery, device removed or renamed?). Used in: {used_in}.

If the device was replaced, choose the new one: House Rules puts it everywhere {entity_id} was used. If the old device comes back, this hint disappears by itself.

error.invalid_entity: Please choose another device that exists.

abort.not_loaded: House Rules is not loaded right now.

alarm_notify_missing.title: House Rules: the alarm's notification service is missing
alarm_notify_missing.description:
The alarm is set to notify through {services}, but this service no longer exists. No message would arrive that way during an alarm.

Check the integration behind it or choose another way under [House Rules → Alarm]({panel}/alarm).

alarm_no_target.title: House Rules: the alarm notifies nobody
alarm_no_target.description:
The alarm is switched on, but nobody would get a message during an alarm: none of the chosen people has the Home Assistant app with notifications, and no other way (e-mail, Telegram, Signal, notification service) is set up.

Set up at least one recipient under [House Rules → Alarm]({panel}/alarm).

heating_no_thermostat.title: House Rules: heating plan for {room} without a thermostat
heating_no_thermostat.description:
The heating plan for **{room}** is on, but the room has no thermostat. The plan cannot control anything there.

Assign a thermostat to the area {room} in Home Assistant or choose it in the room under [House Rules → Heating]({panel}/heat). If the room is not heated, switch its heating plan off.

card_not_loaded.title: The floor plan card is not loaded
card_not_loaded.description:
A dashboard shows the floor plan card (custom:floorplan-card), but nothing loads it: the companion integration “Floor plan card” is not set up and there is no dashboard resource for it. The dashboard therefore shows an error instead of the floor plan.

Add the integration “Floor plan card” under Settings → Devices & services → Add integration. It serves the card to every dashboard.
